symptom: A microflow expression navigating an association builds as `[CE0117] "Error(s) in expression."`, with `exec` and `check --references` both silent, and the same path written fully qualified building clean
cause: Two independent defects in the step that inserts the association's target entity. (a) **Cross-module**: `lookupAssociation` walked only `dm.Associations`, so an association whose target is in another module (a `DomainModels$CrossAssociation`, remote end = BY_NAME `ChildRef`) never resolved and nothing was inserted — the author's short form went through unchanged. (b) **Same-module with the entity named bare**: the skip guard only fired when the next segment was already *qualified*, so `Mod.Assoc/Tag/Label` got the resolved step inserted **in addition**, yielding the four-segment `Mod.Assoc/Mod.Tag/Tag/Label`
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go` (`lookupAssociation` gains the CrossAssociations pass), `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder.go` (`resolvePathSegments` consumes a bare target-entity segment instead of duplicating it)
insight: **Third occurrence of the two-list trap** (#854, issuetracker #19): any code reading associations from a domain model must read `CrossAssociations` too, or every cross-module hop silently no-ops. Grep for `range dm.Associations` before assuming a lookup is complete. **Test the shape the author wrote, not just the shape you expect** — the report was only about cross-module, and the same-module-with-bare-entity case was broken in the opposite direction (over-insertion) and would have survived a cross-module-only fix. **Build a control into one project**: two microflows, short and fully-qualified, gives `1 errors` and names which one; dropping the short one and getting `0 errors` proves it. Cross-module `childPersistable` is unknowable from the local document — the remote entity is not in it — so it must not be read as a fact. Tests `cmd_microflows_assoc_path_test.go`, example `mdl-examples/bug-tests/829-cross-module-assoc-expression.mdl`. upstream #829
